identification: Two cartons of Art and Australia (Ure Smith, Sydney) quarterly journals, roughly 1962/63 to 1980s, perhaps 80 to 100 issues, mostly 1970s-80s common volumes. Photo 2 shows a stack of early issues on top: Vol 1 No 1 May 1963 (edge-worn), Vol 1 No 2 Aug 1963 (note: spine reads 1962 per scan notes; likely 1963), Vol 3 No 1 Jun 1965, Vol 4 No 4 Mar 1967, Vol 6 No 1 Jun 1968, Vol 7 No 3 Dec 1969, Vol 16 No 2 Dec 1978. Large blue-cover issue visible in box 1. Not the earlier Art in Australia (1916-1942) series despite the lot title.

searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline and work) for 'art in australia' and 'art and australia'; Gowans API searches for art and australia, art in australia, art australia journals; WebSearch general, site:armitage.bidsonline.com.au (nothing), Vol 1 No 1 dealer search. Not tried: eBay sold (blocked), Invaluable/LiveAuctioneers (need Chrome). Note the full archive 1963 to present was put online free in 2024 (SLNSW), which depresses collector demand for loose issues. Overall: no recent sold result for a 1960s-80s run; best evidence suggests tens of dollars, perhaps $30 to $80 hammer, with individual early issues worth about $10 to $40 each.
chrome_hint: eBay sold items: 'Art and Australia magazine lot' and 'Art and Australia 1963 Vol 1'; also Invaluable/LiveAuctioneers search 'Art and Australia journal lot'
viewing_check: Count issues in both boxes and note the earliest and latest years; check that the Vol 1 No 1 May 1963 and Vol 1 No 2 copies are complete with covers and not missing pages (spine edge looked damaged); look for any pre-1963 Art in Australia (1916-1942) volumes or deluxe/special issues buried under the top layer; check for damp or mould.
rate_note: AUD sales at face value; GBP converted at assumed 2.0 (unchecked).
